inputs_and_execution_contract.universe: T0 dated TSE domestic common stocks; excludes PRO/foreign/funds; separate v0.2 section 2 tracks
inputs_and_execution_contract.price_and_master: J-Quants V2 raw dated master, unadjusted daily bars, and corporate-action records; preserve original generations
inputs_and_execution_contract.fundamental_sources: Issuer IR/TDnet/EDINET disclosures public by T0 close; all 7 hard gates and 25 score items; NA stops selection
inputs_and_execution_contract.market_regime: MRS-v0.1: official daily TOPIX/Growth250 (J-Quants), adjusted native breadth, full three-year Nikkei VI and latest Cabinet Office CI vintage available by T0
inputs_and_execution_contract.index_access: indices_daily entitlement and replay rights must be verified before use; no paid upgrade or substitute index is authorized by this plan
inputs_and_execution_contract.material_disclosures: All-universe material-disclosure coverage must be certified; absence of a collected document is not proof of no event
inputs_and_execution_contract.evaluation_cutoff: Final TSE trading close at every completed month end; no same-close model fills
inputs_and_execution_contract.model_execution: Buy at the next eligible session open with T0 close +15% limit; sell at the next eligible session close; board lot 100; participation normal 5%/immediate 10%; fee 0.15%, slippage 0.10% separately; taxes excluded
inputs_and_execution_contract.missing_data: WAIT; no forced trades; no synthetic run or retrospective proxy counts
inputs_and_execution_contract.period_closure: Do not extend dates or relax the 10-trade requirement after seeing outcomes; insufficient observations are INCONCLUSIVE
inputs_and_execution_contract.broker_submission: HUMAN_ONLY; this plan creates no broker order
